mapper.select: select A.blockNo, A.blockName, A.version, A.gc_product, A.partType, A.uom, A.block_opt, A.pick, A.pickName, A.qty, A.UOM, A.MODDATE, A.cmt, A.color from BLOCK_HISTORY A where A.module = #{blockNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BLOCK_HISTORY(BLOCKNO, BLOCKNAME, VERSION, UOM, GC_PRODUCT, PARTTYPE, BLOCK_OPT, MODDATE, CREDATE, PICK, PICKNAME, QTY, CMT, COLOR) VALUES(#{blockDto.blockNo}, #{blockDto.blockName}, #{blockDto.version}, #{blockDto.uom}, #{blockDto.gc_product}, #{blockDto.partType}, #{blockDto.block_opt}, #{blockDto.modDate}, #{blockDto.creDate}, #{blockDto.pick}, #{blockDto.pickName}, #{blockDto.qty}, #{blockDto.cmt}, #{blockDto.color})
mapper.select: select A.blockNo, A.blockName, A.version, A.gc_product, A.partType, A.uom, A.block_opt, A.pick, A.pickName, A.qty, A.UOM, A.MODDATE, A.cmt, A.color from BLOCK_HISTORY A where A.blockNo = #{blockNo}

SELECT A.md$number AS PARTNO, A.md$desc AS PART_NAME, A.BLOCKNO_NUMBER AS BLOCKNO, A.spec, A.g_l_code GL_CODE, A.PART_SIZE, A.nation, CODN(A.NATION) AS NA, --Ownership cod(A.uom) AS UOM, CODN(A.origin_div) origin_div, --외주 cod(A.spt) spt, A.PART_STATUS, CODN(A.part_status) part_status, A.old_code, A.old_code2, A.old_code3, old_code4 FROM normalpart$vf A, normalpart$id B WHERE A.vf$ouid = B.id$last AND LENGTH (A.md$number)=11 AND A.NATION = 2803457356
and A.BLOCKNO_NUMBER like concat('%', #{blockNo}, '%')
and A.md$number like concat('%', #{partNo}, '%')
and A.md$desc like concat('%', #{md$desc}, '%')
and CODN(A.origin_div) like concat('%', #{div}, '%')
